notes: Adds safe duplicate handling for Source Documents. When multiple records point to the same retained source, TEE identifies a single archived record with saved information as authoritative and marks incomplete no-details records as removable duplicates. Duplicate removal is allowed only while the vault is unlocked and only after TEE re-validates that the candidate has no saved details and a separate authoritative record exists. The authoritative record and its protected source are not changed.
name: TEE v3.4.40 — Source Document Duplicate Guard Review
